name: open-bridge-mods
description: Claude Code mods that ship with open-bridge (function hooks, early access). Add from the Bridge folder with: claude plugin marketplace add ./mods

plugins.name: briefing-ui
plugins.description: The briefing as a clickable dashboard in Claude Code (German or English): decide with buttons, hand topics to new cmux tabs, watch running tabs. Active only with briefing.claude_code_ui.enabled in bridge-config.yaml; tabs, columns and marks come from the briefing profile.
